name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.OrderLock.out_first_example_lock
title: With the output gate first in the level order, the 4-variable NAND Tseitin CNF is still locked: pinning out = 1, class-covered moves and low cover flips never yield an all-ones slot
statement: Levels 0..3 carry out, w, n1, n2 (output first), with n1 = NAND(w, w), n2 = NAND(w, n1), out = NAND(n2, n2); the eight Tseitin clauses with the unit clause (out) are unsatisfiable. Start from zero programs and these eight clause cubes. If every step changes one slot either so that every string alive in the new slot is alive, before the step, in a slot with the same level-1 entries, or by a cover flip at a level L < 2 (cover agrees with the slot below L, has entry 1 at (L, b), is all ones after L, and only (L, b) changes), then no slot is ever all-ones.
